observations: Viewed baseline and candidate face crops and complete stages for all three accepted views, 12 PNGs in total.
Adult support: eyelid fold edges are slightly cleaner and more continuous. The supporting hand overlap and facial expression appear preserved.

Adult unobstructed head: finer, more consistent eyelid crease edges are visible in the close-up. No new gaps or unwanted overlap are apparent. The head silhouette, nose, mouth, ears, and collar appear unchanged.

Infant high contrast at narrow width: both closed-eye outlines remain legible, the white facial area and existing nose contour are retained, and hand placement is preserved. The lid changes are subtle at this scale with no visible regression.
The parent confirmed all three accepted native workflows passed; each corresponding summary was also checked for the frozen candidate hash, unchanged inputs, and one successful test.
limitations: Review covers three fixed raw-module browser views only, not every age, camera angle, animation frame, or pose.
This visual review does not test the full application loader, deployment, or clinical correctness.
